identity_note: Provider crosswalk assets exist in the mbb_crosswalk release and their column sets were verified-by-pull (see samples 4-5), but the crosswalk is NOT admitted as an identity mapping: matches are confidence-scored (match_method / match_confidence columns), no NCAA game-ID column was observed, and 2027-season coverage is unverified. Identity joins remain OPEN. Name-only joins are refused.
known_limitations: RELEASE TAGS ARE ROLLING, NOT IMMUTABLE: the schedules release was published 2023-03-29 and its assets were still being replaced in place on 2026-10-18. A tag alone pins nothing; the pin is tag + asset ID + asset size + asset updated_at + SHA-256 at pull time.
Format drift inside one release: for season 2027 the parquet schedule asset was updated 2026-10-18 while the CSV twin was updated 2026-09-15. Formats must be pinned and verified independently.

The 2027 schedule sample is PARTIAL (1,629 rows vs roughly 5,800 games in a full Division I season): it is a preliminary schedule, NOT an admitted slate. Slates are admitted only by the CBB capture/readiness process.

player_box_2026.parquet bytes and SHA-256 are verified-by-pull; its row count and schema are documented-only in this record (no working parquet reader in the SportsEdge runtime at admission time; the wheel install was broken). HoopR documentation describes the player box contents.

The hoopR-mbb-data repository itself (in-tree mbb/ parquet directories, docs) is CC BY 4.0; the downloadable substrate admitted here is the sportsdataverse-data release asset set (MIT). The two must not be conflated.
pin_rule: tag + asset_id + asset size + asset updated_at + sha256 of downloaded bytes, all recorded in this manifest at pull time. Any later byte drift is SOURCE_CHANGED_AFTER_SNAPSHOT (refusal), never silent acceptance.
